sourceAuthority: Official LEGO building instructions; direct completed-model appearance and build-sequence audit

officialCompletedModelRaster.provenance: Unaltered raster of official instruction page 1; rendered at 1100px maximum edge for review display.

directlyObservedStructure: Completed horizontal spacecraft with forward cockpit/nose, long central red honeycomb solar-panel section and rear circular engine/ring with upright fin.
Forward cockpit/nose is assembled on pages 3-7.
Central solar section is assembled on pages 8-17 and joins the forward section axially.
Rear engine/ring section is assembled on pages 18-23 and joins at the aft end.
Rover and probe/equipment are auxiliary separate builds, not spacecraft chassis.
Pages 24-26 are cross-set alternate builds using sets 7312, 7313 and 7316.
sourceDoesNotDemonstrate: Game deployment or detachment of the central solar/lab section.
Tracks, wheels, rails or an automotive ground carrier.
directorCorrection: Treat ground in the gameplay specification as a movement/targeting layer; preserve Solar Explorer as a spacecraft.

adaptations: The central solar/lab section separates intact as the Forward Service / field-lab module.
The remaining cockpit/nose and rear engine sections reconnect axially into a shorter spacecraft configuration.
Simple short landing feet support the deployed field lab; no wheels, tracks, rails or automotive chassis.
Keep the rover and probe/equipment as small separate auxiliary elements.

targetImage.provenance: Director-selected light beige T083 target image: complete LEGO 7315 spacecraft and deployed central lab configuration, with separate source-like rover and probe/equipment.

productionTarget.acceptance: Director accepted this Production Design Target on 2026-09-24; T084 authorized for this unit only and not started.
